entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A dragon-shapeshifting planeswalker who travels to Tarkir's past, fights to save Ugin, and ultimately cocoons him in hedron.

entities.name: Ugin, the Spirit Dragon
entities.description: A shimmering, ghostlike spirit dragon planeswalker, progenitor of Tarkir's dragons, who is struck down by Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An unfathomably ancient elder dragon planeswalker and Sarkhan's most hated enemy, who comes to destroy Ugin.

entities.name: Yasova
entities.description: The Temur khan of this era, who unknowingly follows Bolas's guidance and casts a claw-rune spell that turns the dragons against Ugin.

entities.name: Yasova's sabertooth cat
entities.description: Yasova's sabertooth, which digs Sarkhan out of the snow.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where Sarkhan travels back in time to a dragon-filled age.

entities.name: The Temur clan
entities.description: The clan led by the khan Yasova in this era.

entities.name: The hedron shard
entities.description: A piece of Ugin's chamber on Zendikar, which Sarkhan unfolds into a protective cocoon around Ugin.

entities.name: The Eye of Ugin
entities.description: Ugin's chamber on Zendikar, a place to contain the Eldrazi and to recuperate.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the Eye of Ugin stands.

entities.name: The Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings contained by a spell at the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: The temporal nexus
entities.description: The chasm punched into the land where Ugin's body fell; the site of the temporal nexus in Sarkhan's own time.

entities.name: The Unwritten Now
entities.description: Yasova's term for the present that she believes will be free of the blight of dragons.

events.summary: Sarkhan, flying in dragon form toward the tempests, despairs that Bolas's influence has already reached this ancient time.
events.quote: the influence of Bolas had somehow made it here before him

events.summary: Sarkhan realizes the circular chain: Bolas killed Ugin, ending the dragons, which led Sarkhan to revere dragons and bow to Bolas.
events.quote: Bolas had killed Ugin over some ancient feud.

events.summary: Sarkhan resolves to climb and reforge the chain, holding the hedron shard from Ugin's chamber.
events.quote: If he was still here, still alive, then there was a chance he could reforge the chain.

events.summary: Sarkhan breaks through the clouds and sees Ugin flying like a comet, and resolves to help him fight Bolas.
events.quote: The shimmering, ghostlike dragon Ugin flew across the atmosphere like a comet, dragging a tail made of storm.

events.summary: Sarkhan sees Yasova's claw-rune pathway tracking the tempests, meant as a guide for Bolas.
events.quote: This pattern was meant to be seen from the air—by Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas appears in Ugin's path and the two dragon planeswalkers face off.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas appeared out of a ripple of sky

events.summary: Ugin roars and calls Tarkir's dragons to his side; they stream out of the tempests.
events.quote: Dragons appeared in droves, flying out of the dragon tempests toward the fight.

events.summary: Bolas and Ugin trade spells; Bolas barrages Ugin, who counterattacks.
events.quote: Bolas slapped away half of the assaults, but many of them landed

events.summary: Yasova's elemental spell strikes dozens of dragons, including Sarkhan, and turns them against Ugin.
events.quote: Yasova's power drowned out the force of Ugin's call, and the dragons converged on Ugin instead of Bolas.

events.summary: Sarkhan fights the spell, shouts no, and forces himself out of dragon form, then falls.
events.quote: as he forced himself out of dragon form

events.summary: The Tarkir dragons attack Ugin while Bolas watches, and Bolas delivers the deathblow that breaks Ugin's body.
events.quote: Bolas's final blow, the battle-ending deathblow that broke Ugin's body

events.summary: Sarkhan crashes down a crag and is buried by an avalanche.
events.quote: He held onto a thread of consciousness, enough to tell him that he was dying.

events.summary: Yasova's sabertooth digs Sarkhan out, and Yasova begins healing him.
events.quote: It was Yasova's sabertooth cat, clearing snow with great swipes of its paws.

events.summary: Ugin's body hits the tundra, creating a chasm at the site of the temporal nexus.
events.quote: It was the same place Sarkhan had come to in his own time—the site of the temporal nexus.

events.summary: Bolas turns toward the sky and vanishes.
events.quote: Sarkhan glanced up to see Nicol Bolas turn toward the sky and vanish.

events.summary: Sarkhan blasts Yasova with dragon fire when she tries to stop him from saving Ugin.
events.quote: blasting Yasova full on in the chest

events.summary: Sarkhan finds Ugin barely breathing at the bottom of the chasm.
events.quote: Sarkhan's heart leaped when he saw that a slow exhale was escaping the dragon's nostrils.

events.summary: Sarkhan, hearing the mocking voice of his own mind, realizes the lesson and gives Ugin the hedron shard.
events.quote: "Ugin, I've brought something for you," he said.

events.summary: Sarkhan breathes on the hedron shard, which unfolds into a protective cocoon around Ugin.
events.quote: The protective cocoon assembled itself around Ugin now, hiding him away from Sarkhan

events.summary: The dragon tempests churn with new vigor and new dragons erupt, showing that Ugin's magic persists.
events.quote: New dragons erupted from them, shrieking with the simple, unrestrained glory of being.

events.summary: Sarkhan realizes the chain has a purpose, thanks Yasova, and is whisked away by temporal forces.
events.quote: —temporal forces whisked Sarkhan away.

relations.note: Bolas is Sarkhan's most hated enemy
relations.quote: her patron is—or will later become—Sarkhan's most hated enemy
The great elder dragon's attention was focused on Ugin, the one he had come to destroy.

relations.note: Yasova is khan of the Temur clan
relations.quote: Yasova, khan of this era's Temur clan

relations.note: Yasova follows a dragon's guidance, which is Bolas
relations.quote: she is following the guidance of a dragon as well
Or at least he would help Ugin fight Bolas when the time came, so Ugin would survive
Bolas's final blow, the battle-ending deathblow that broke Ugin's body

relations.note: Sarkhan blasts Yasova with fire when she tries to stop him
relations.quote: He lashed an accusatory hand at the ancient Temur khan.

relations.note: The sabertooth stays near its unconscious master
